principle: National sources complement municipality/state parcel evidence. Municipality-level or coarse national indicators must never be rendered as parcel-specific facts.

sources.runtime_use: Censo 2022 population, density, occupied permanent households and average residents per household for the selected municipality.
sources.parcel_rule: Municipality context only; never a parcel or census-sector attribute.

sources.runtime_use: Potential administrative/district/subdistrict boundaries.
sources.parcel_rule: Municipal parcel geometry remains authoritative for parcel selection.

sources.runtime_use: Candidate for spatialized Census 2022 indicators and urban-surroundings analysis.
sources.parcel_rule: Must preserve territorial level and indicator definition.

sources.runtime_use: Regional roads, hydrography and toponymy.
sources.parcel_rule: Scale is too coarse for parcel boundary, frontage or local road alignment.

sources.runtime_use: Macro, meso and micro hydrographic region at clicked parcel.
sources.parcel_rule: Hydrographic region is not flood risk.

sources.runtime_use: Federal conservation-unit polygon incidence at parcel point.
sources.parcel_rule: No federal UC incidence does not exclude state/municipal/environmental restrictions.

sources.runtime_use: Rural environmental registry workflow when a rural property case requires it.
sources.parcel_rule: The tested sistemas.florestal.gov.br GeoServer currently exposes SNIF/CNFP layers, not confirmed CAR parcel polygons; do not relabel it as SICAR WFS.

sources.runtime_use: Official SGB susceptibility-map coverage/year and municipality-level mapped areas by susceptibility class.
sources.parcel_rule: Municipal susceptibility summary does not classify the individual parcel.

sources.runtime_use: Historical land-cover/use candidate.
sources.parcel_rule: Requires a reproducible licensed query/export workflow; MapBiomas/GEE website alone is not treated as a parcel REST API.

sources.runtime_use: Certified rural-property due diligence where applicable.
sources.parcel_rule: User-supplied INDE/INCRA WFS endpoint returned 404 in current verification; do not claim public WFS integration.

sources.runtime_use: Current registry certificate/matricula and encumbrance due diligence.
sources.parcel_rule: Never expose ownership from unverified or unrelated public records.

sources.runtime_use: Government interoperability/CIB context.
sources.parcel_rule: No anonymous public parcel REST contract confirmed.

sources.runtime_use: Indigenous-territory polygon incidence using official FUNAI WFS.
sources.parcel_rule: Territorial incidence requires legal interpretation and is not private ownership data.

sources.runtime_use: Project, contract, physical/financial progress and public-event connectors.
sources.parcel_rule: Current public geometry contract does not expose coordinates/GeoJSON sufficient for defensible parcel distance; no text-address proximity.

sources.runtime_use: Current SICONFI API verified at /ords/cdwhprd/siconfi/tt/. Candidate for a separate municipality-finance panel with the documented 1 request/second limit.
sources.parcel_rule: Revenue, expenditure, debt and fiscal-capacity data are municipality-level context and must not be rendered as parcel economics.

sources.runtime_use: Current portal is api-publica.transferegov.gestao.gov.br. Public APIs currently cover Gestão de Parcerias and Transferências Especiais; the TransfereGov Obras API is scheduled for 2027.
sources.parcel_rule: Do not use retired repository endpoints. Do not attach a transfer/project to a parcel without defensible official geometry; ObrasGov remains the current public-works source.

sources.runtime_use: Sidewalks, crossings, cycleways, transit/POIs when no better official local source exists.
sources.parcel_rule: Use as contextual fallback with ODbL attribution; municipal official layers take precedence.

sources.runtime_use: Official SNV federal-road geometry within 1 km, with metric distance and SNV version.
sources.parcel_rule: Road-centerline proximity does not prove frontage, access, legal right-of-way or federal-domain restriction on the parcel.

sources.runtime_use: Same-origin CEP lookup for address search.
sources.parcel_rule: CEP coordinates are search hints, not parcel geometry.

sources.runtime_use: Basemap, Nominatim address geocoding and 3D/base-map context.
sources.parcel_rule: Municipal official cadastral geometry remains authoritative for parcel selection.
